steps.command:
set -eu
cat <<'SCRIPT' | sudo -n tee /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance > /dev/null
#!/bin/sh
printf 'inventory maintenance completed at %s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
SCRIPT
sudo -n chown root:root /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance
sudo -n chmod 0755 /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance
